```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY ent 'Parsed Entity'>">
  %param;
  <?target-pi data="processing instruction content"?>
  <!-- DTD level comment -->
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Document level comment before CDATA -->
  <sub:child id="1">
    <![CDATA[ CDATA section containing <tags> and &ent; references inside ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&ent;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ext-sys SYSTEM "http://example.com/dtd">
  <!ENTITY local-ent "Local Entity Value">
  <?catalog-pi action="refresh"?>
  <!-- Internal DTD subset comment -->
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://xml.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Header comment -->
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"?>
  <item xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw text <>&'"" inside CDATA block.
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>&local-ent;</item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (doc*)>
  <!ELEMENT doc (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; and Second Entity">
  <!ENTITY % p-ent "<!ELEMENT doc (#PCDATA)>">
  %p-ent;
  <?xml-init config="debug"?>
  <!-- DTD comment block -->
]>
<archive xmlns="http://schema.org/archive" xmlns:meta="http://schema.org/meta">
  <meta:info>
    <!-- Metadata comment -->
    <?meta-pi load="true"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA block with entity-like text &ent1;
    ]]>
  </meta:info>
  <doc>&ent2;</doc>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE config [
  <!ELEMENT config (setting*)>
  <!ELEMENT setting (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseValue">
  <!ENTITY derived "&base;-Derived">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <?config-processor mode="strict"?>
  <!-- DTD comment explaining entities -->
]>
<config xmlns="http://example.org/config" xmlns:cfg="http://example.org/config/settings">
  <!-- Primary config section -->
  <cfg:setting name="test">
    <![CDATA[
      Value: &derived; with <markup>
    ]]>
  </cfg:setting>
  <setting>&derived;</setting>
</config>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE suite [
  <!ELEMENT suite (testcase+)>
  <!ELEMENT testcase (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY test-ent "ExpandedText">
  <!ENTITY % macro-ent "<!ENTITY inner-ent 'MacroExpanded'>">
  %macro-ent;
  <?suite-meta author="QA"?>
  <!-- Suite DTD comment -->
]>
<suite xmlns="http://test.org/suite" xmlns:tr="http://test.org/suite/tr">
  <!-- Test case wrapper -->
  <tr:testcase id="t1">
    <?tr-action run="always"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with &test-ent; and &inner-ent;
    ]]>
  </tr:testcase>
  <testcase>&inner-ent;</testcase>
</suite>
```
